Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MA.
Our cloud segment grew 3% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 3% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2021.
We delivered record revenue of $34.5 billion this quarter, representing 3% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 128 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.71 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
